exercises.title: Exercise 2 — join four tables: projects in TP Hồ Chí Minh
exercises.problemHtml:
For every project located in TP Hồ Chí Minh, give the project name, the name of the department that controls it, and its manager written as Name (SSN).

FUHCompany schema (the course's sample database — full script in the FUHCompany.sql tab)
TableColumns (PK underlined, FK in italics)
tblEmployeeempSSN DECIMAL(18,0), empName NVARCHAR(50), empAddress NVARCHAR(100), empSalary DECIMAL(10,0), empSex CHAR(1) (F/M), empBirthdate DATE, depNum → tblDepartment, supervisorSSN → tblEmployee
tblDepartmentdepNum INT, depName NVARCHAR(50) UNIQUE, mgrSSN → tblEmployee, mgrAssDate DATE
tblProjectproNum INT, proName NVARCHAR(50), locNum → tblLocation, depNum → tblDepartment
tblWorksOnempSSN, proNum, workHours DECIMAL(5,1)
tblLocationlocNum INT, locName NVARCHAR(50) UNIQUE
tblDepLocationdepNum, locNum
tblDependentempSSN, depName NVARCHAR(50), depSex CHAR(1), depBirthdate DATE, depRelationship NVARCHAR(30)

14 employees, 5 departments, 6 projects, 16 work assignments, 5 dependents. Names are Vietnamese with diacritics; text compares case-insensitively as on SQL Server.

Requirements

  • Columns: proName, depName, manager.
  • Build the text with CONCAT(m.empName, ' (', CAST(m.empSSN AS VARCHAR(20)), ')') — the + operator for strings is SQL Server only. Row order does not matter.

  • Dựng chuỗi bằng CONCAT(m.empName, ' (', CAST(m.empSSN AS VARCHAR(20)), ')') — toán tử + cho chuỗi chỉ có ở SQL Server. Thứ tự dòng không quan trọng.

CREATE TABLE tblLocation (
    locNum   INT           NOT NULL,
    locName  NVARCHAR(50)  NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_location      PRIMARY KEY (locNum),
    CONSTRAINT uq_location_name UNIQUE (locName)
);

CREATE TABLE tblDepartment (
    depNum      INT            NOT NULL,
    depName     NVARCHAR(50)   NOT NULL,
    mgrSSN      DECIMAL(18,0)  NULL,
    mgrAssDate  DATE           NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_department      PRIMARY KEY (depNum),
    CONSTRAINT uq_department_name UNIQUE (depName)
);

CREATE TABLE tblEmployee (
    empSSN         DECIMAL(18,0)  NOT NULL,
    empName        NVARCHAR(50)   NOT NULL,
    empAddress     NVARCHAR(100)  NULL,
    empSalary      DECIMAL(10,0)  NULL,
    empSex         CHAR(1)        NULL,
    empBirthdate   DATE           NULL,
    depNum         INT            NULL,
    supervisorSSN  DECIMAL(18,0)  NULL,

    CONSTRAINT ck_employee_salary     CHECK (empSalary > 0),
    CONSTRAINT fk_employee_department FOREIGN KEY (depNum)        REFERENCES tblDepartment (depNum),
    CONSTRAINT fk_employee_supervisor FOREIGN KEY (supervisorSSN) REFERENCES tblEmployee (empSSN)
);

CREATE TABLE tblDepLocation (
    depNum  INT  NOT NULL,
    locNum  INT  NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_deplocation            PRIMARY KEY (depNum, locNum),
    CONSTRAINT fk_deplocation_department FOREIGN KEY (depNum) REFERENCES tblDepartment (depNum),
    CONSTRAINT fk_deplocation_location   FOREIGN KEY (locNum) REFERENCES tblLocation (locNum)
);

CREATE TABLE tblProject (
    proNum   INT           NOT NULL,
    proName  NVARCHAR(50)  NOT NULL,
    locNum   INT           NULL,
    depNum   INT           NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_project            PRIMARY KEY (proNum),
    CONSTRAINT fk_project_location   FOREIGN KEY (locNum) REFERENCES tblLocation (locNum),
    CONSTRAINT fk_project_department FOREIGN KEY (depNum) REFERENCES tblDepartment (depNum)
);

CREATE TABLE tblWorksOn (
    empSSN     DECIMAL(18,0)  NOT NULL,
    proNum     INT            NOT NULL,
    workHours  DECIMAL(5,1)   NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_workson          PRIMARY KEY (empSSN, proNum),
    CONSTRAINT ck_workson_hours    CHECK (workHours >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT fk_workson_employee FOREIGN KEY (empSSN) REFERENCES tblEmployee (empSSN),
    CONSTRAINT fk_workson_project  FOREIGN KEY (proNum) REFERENCES tblProject (proNum)
);

CREATE TABLE tblDependent (
    depName          NVARCHAR(50)   NOT NULL,
    empSSN           DECIMAL(18,0)  NOT NULL,

solutionCodeJson.name: query.sql
solutionCodeJson.code:
SELECT p.proName, d.depName,
       CONCAT(m.empName, ' (', CAST(m.empSSN AS VARCHAR(20)), ')') AS manager
FROM tblProject p
JOIN tblLocation   l ON l.locNum = p.locNum        -- to test the city
JOIN tblDepartment d ON d.depNum = p.depNum        -- the controlling department
JOIN tblEmployee   m ON m.empSSN = d.mgrSSN        -- m = the manager (a role of tblEmployee)
WHERE l.locName = N'TP Hồ Chí Minh';

SELECT p.proName, l.locName, SUM(w.workHours) AS totalHours
FROM tblProject p
JOIN tblLocation l ON l.locNum = p.locNum
JOIN tblWorksOn  w ON w.proNum = p.proNum
GROUP BY p.proNum, p.proName, l.locName        -- every non-aggregated column of SELECT
HAVING SUM(w.workHours) > 50;

exercises.title: Exercise 7a — the largest department(s) with TOP 1 WITH TIES
exercises.problemHtml:
Create a view vLargestDepartments(depNum, depName, numEmployees) showing the department(s) with the most employees — all departments tied for first place. On FUHCompany departments 1 and 2 both have 4 employees.

Runs on YOUR SQL Server, not in the browser. TOP … WITH TIES is SQL Server syntax (PostgreSQL writes FETCH FIRST … WITH TIES), so it is checked on a real SQL Server. Nothing here is graded automatically: run the self-check check.sql on your machine and, when it prints ALL 3 CHECKS PASSED, press Mark as solved.

How to run it (Windows or macOS)

Press Tải .zip (download) above the code and unzip it. The folder has three files: setup.sql (re-creates a scratch database DBI202_CL with the sample tables), solution.sql (YOUR answer — edit only this one) and check.sql (3 checks; prints PASS/FAIL for each and ends with ALL 3 CHECKS PASSED). Always run them in this order: setup → solution → check.

  • Windows + SSMS (the course setup, lesson 0.3): open setup.sql → F5; open solution.sql → F5; open check.sql → F5, then read the Messages tab. Or in a terminal inside the folder (sqlcmd ships with SQL Server; otherwise winget install sqlcmd):
    sqlcmd -S localhost -E -C -i setup.sql,solution.sql,check.sql (use -U sa -P "<password>" instead of -E for a SQL login).
  • macOS (SQL Server in Docker, as in lesson 0.3 — Apple Silicon: mcr.microsoft.com/azure-sql-edge, Intel: mcr.microsoft.com/mssql/server:2022-latest):
    docker run -d --name dbi202-sql -e ACCEPT_EULA=Y -e "MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD=Dbi202#Lab" -p 1433:1433 mcr.microsoft.com/azure-sql-edge
    then install the command-line client once with brew install sqlcmd and, inside the folder:
    sqlcmd -S localhost,1433 -U sa -P "Dbi202#Lab" -C -i setup.sql,solution.sql,check.sql
    (or open the three files in VS Code with the SQL Server (mssql) extension and run them in the same order).

Use CREATE OR ALTER for procedures, functions, triggers and views so that you can run solution.sql again and again. In the real PE you submit only the CREATE … statement, without GO or test commands.

Requirements

  • CREATE OR ALTER VIEW vLargestDepartments AS SELECT TOP (1) WITH TIES …
  • The ORDER BY inside the view is allowed only because of TOP.
